decisions.decision: Stamp manifest Version X.Y.Z.0 at assemble and write release.json with the exact tag
decisions.why: Stream Deck versions are numeric only; prerelease ordering needs the full semver
decisions.rejected: Bumping the source manifest per release, or encoding rc in the 4th number

decisions.why: Already version-free, so stable across releases
decisions.rejected: Renaming to a versioned or distribution name

decisions.decision: Stable-tag release notes start at the previous stable tag
decisions.why: Stable users must see everything since their last stable
Excludes drafts and prereleases; far below anonymous limits; no dependency

decisions.decision: Download via Node, verify SHA256SUMS, hand over with /usr/bin/open
decisions.why: Stream Deck shows its own install prompt; Node-written files carry no quarantine
decisions.rejected: openUrl with file URL; unpacking in place

decisions.decision: macOS notification via osascript with argv
decisions.why: No native code or dependency; failure tolerated
decisions.rejected: UNUserNotificationCenter in the signed helper app

decisions.decision: Persist updates {autoCheck, notifiedVersion} in schema-2 global settings
decisions.why: Same store as language; survives plugin updates

decisions.decision: launch_blocked category from a quarantine xattr probe after launch failure
decisions.why: Deterministic signal for the ad-hoc downloaded-installer case

decisions.decision: Local builds are X.Y.Z.N: nearest tag plus a per-build counter in dist/plugin-build-number; releases are X.Y.Z.0
decisions.why: Owner request: a local build sorts above its release and below the next, so the next release is offered
decisions.rejected: Commit count since tag as N (does not grow on rebuilds)

decisions.decision: Download redirect host is not pinned; only HTTPS plus SHA256SUMS match
decisions.why: GitHub redirects assets to release-assets.githubusercontent.com; pinning would break real downloads

decisions.decision: update.status is requested when the Lamp and connection screen opens; the action panel gets update via the inspector.get snapshot
decisions.why: Avoids queuing ahead of user actions on every panel open
decisions.rejected: Separate update.status on every panel open

decisions.decision: Release page shown as plain-text URL
decisions.why: Panel can only sendToPlugin in the current harness

decisions.decision: Added scene to staged image KINDS
decisions.why: Pre-existing gap: scene icons were never staged, so full package checks would reject the payload
decisions.rejected: Leaving it for a separate fix

decisions.decision: Release page opens through the Stream Deck openUrl event from the PI
decisions.why: A PI anchor does not reliably reach the default browser; openUrl is the SDK event and needs no new plugin message
decisions.rejected: a new update.openRelease message type outside the contract

decisions.decision: Install is rejected once the installer was handed to Stream Deck
decisions.why: Contract section 6 allows install only from available or dismissed
decisions.rejected: keeping re-open after a cancelled Stream Deck prompt (would need a contract change)
